Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: final high-fidelity art-directed desktop GAME SCREEN reference for enGAN.AI. Landscape 16:9, entire screen edge to edge, no device mockup, no browser chrome.
Input images: Image 1 (user inspiration) is a COMPOSITION AND ADVENTURE GAME REFERENCE, not a copy target. Image 2 is the existing Fifi CHARACTER CONTINUITY reference. Image 3 is the existing Lupa CHARACTER CONTINUITY reference. Evolve them deliberately toward the user's adventure-game reference.
Primary request: Design screen 01, the IMMERSIVE MAIN MENU of an educational game about a GAN learning to generate Fashion-MNIST clothing. It must feel like entering a crafted indie detective adventure, with scene and characters carrying the screen. Extremely clear senior game UI hierarchy.
Visual direction: "The Pixel Investigation Atelier". A believable illustrated retrofuturist workshop at night, quiet charcoal/navy #141923, warm off-white #eee9dd, desaturated plum #775569 associated with Fifi and muted petrol teal #487578 associated with Lupa. Tiny warm amber #e5b664 reserved for the primary button and one lamp. At least 80 percent of frame neutral/dark. Soft cinematic lighting, tactile matte materials, hand-painted 3D illustration, subtle depth and warm shadows, carefully restrained contrast. NO electric magenta/cyan wash, NO RGB borders, NO neon outlines, NO ubiquitous glow, NO glitter/stars/confetti.
Characters: Fifi on LEFT, resourceful mischievous artist robot in a muted plum hooded jacket with a small stitched G patch and a paintbrush, ivory rounded screen frame and warm coral expressive eyes; playful, not evil. Lupa on RIGHT, ivory/petrol robot detective in a modest worn tan coat and dark teal detective cap, expressive turquoise eyes, holding a magnifying glass. Recognizable continuity with reference faces, but less babyish: smaller eyes, simpler expressions, slightly longer bodies, heads roughly 45 percent of total height. No eyelashes or human hair. They are physically in the room, not inside hero cards.
Composition: full background scene. Large Fifi occupies left 27%, Lupa right 28%, middle 40% has generous calm dark negative space. Wordmark at top center exactly "enGAN.AI", custom bold slightly playful cream typography, only ".AI" amber. Below it small subtitle exactly "A GUERRA DOS PIXELS". Central copy only two short lines exactly "Uma cria. A outra investiga." and "E você entra nessa disputa." One large warm amber tactile game button centered below: "Começar missão" with a small play triangle. A quiet secondary text button below exactly "Explorar o GANLab". Small understated role labels near characters "Fifi · Gerador" and "Lupa · Discriminador".
HUD: top LEFT a tiny back arrow with "ChAprendizagem"; top RIGHT small elegant sound-off and help icons only, no account, no fake XP. Bottom center small text "Engana aí. Aprende aqui." A few monochrome pixelated clothing evidence prints on the workbench, and one small floating pixel shirt between the rivals. Background details must stay dark and blurred away from the controls.
Constraints: Portuguese text must be legible and accurate, keep text minimal. No sidebar, no website landing-page sections, no rows of feature cards, no dashboard, no fake metrics, no rankings, no photorealistic AI-image examples. New logo must be enGAN.AI, never GANtástico. This is a design concept screenshot, not an implemented UI or scientific result.
